observations: All 16 whole pages (source, d1, d3, d6) and all 16 d3 partial pages were visually reviewed.
Curves including faint/repeated input, a wide line, crossing, junction and blank are recognizable and broadly crisp. No broad gray halo was seen in generated regions.

Clear pair04 forms a closed outline with small interior dots; crossing06 also has stray dots. Taper03 is not faithfully preserved. Broken sketch09 is not reconnected. Short wide11 has small endpoint fragments.

Fill12 fails severely with large patterned holes. Fill13 and the fill in mixed15 collapse to a centerline plus dots. These are new-size generalization failures and this model is not suitable for reliable fill reconstruction.
Mixed15 also closes pair endpoints and joins a nearly touching gap.
Partial protected areas are byte-exact by the automated BGRA check; their gray input remains intentionally.
No reselection or tuning on these heldout outputs. Ship the frozen model only as a limited Krita preview, not as meeting all quality goals.
